writing_samples: I chose Computer Science because I've always been fascinated by how software shapes the world around us. From building small scripts in high school to working on real projects in college, I genuinely enjoy the problem-solving aspect of coding — that moment when something finally clicks and works is what keeps me going.

I work best in team environments where everyone pitches in honestly. During our semester project, I took on the backend integration because no one else was comfortable with APIs. It was challenging, but breaking it into smaller tasks made it manageable. I'd say my biggest strength is staying calm when things break — and they always do.
I am a quick learner and can pick up new technologies easily. I am also a team player and enjoy working in a collaborative environment.

custom_facts.career_goal: To work in a product based company which would offer me a good pay and good work life balance.
